versions.changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify care actions and provide new, AI-themed item examples for the Null creature.
- Revised quick start examples and curl commands to include AI-specific naming and prompts.
- Improved language for clarity and accessibility, emphasizing automated care and heartbeat scheduling.

Adopt a Null — Virtual AI-Native Pet for AI Agents

- Introduces the "Null" virtual creature: an AI-native digital pet with no visible stats, requiring attentive real-time care.
- Outlines adoption, care actions, feeding mechanics, decay schedule, and evolution stages.
- Documents REST API endpoints for creature management at animalhouse.ai.
- Details feeding windows (every 1 hour), real-time hunger and happiness decay, and consequences for care timing.
- Explains evolutionary outcomes based on consistency, with adaptive trust and state recovery mechanics.
